lessons: (after campaign 0) Exploratory screen magnitudes are not calibrated effect sizes (2 panels, noisy, multiple-comparisons/winner's-curse risk) — use them only to rank candidates, preregister confirmatory tests with fixed splits/metrics before running, and expect the confirmed effect to shrink toward zero relative to the screen, especially for the top-ranked pick.

(after campaign 1) Kill decisively-negative screen results (clip_outliers at -13.74%) without spending confirmatory budget, and keep methodologically distinct variants of the same idea (naive vs. bias-corrected log-transform) as separate preregistered hypotheses rather than conflating them under one hid — a null on one doesn't license inference about the other.

(after campaign 2) When the champion configuration changes (e.g., adding yoy), old prereg statements/constraints written against the prior champion become stale and silently conflict with frozen configs that correctly inherit the new champion's features — before locking any new prereg, explicitly re-derive both arms from the *current* champion definition rather than copying language from an earlier campaign's statement.
